newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sammi fails to honour promissory notes.
newsitem.headline: Sammi fails to honour promissory notes.

text.p: Sammi Steel Co has failed to honour about 1.1 billion won worth of promissory notes due on Tuesday, main creditor Korea First Bank said on Wednesday.
Sammi risked defaulting on the notes unless it paid the sum by the end of Wednesday, the bank said.
"Sammi has failed to honour the promissory notes. If it misses another deadline set for the end of today, it would be legally defaulting on the notes," a Korea First official said.
Sammi Steel, South Korea's largest specialty steel products maker, and its four affiliates have applied for court receivership.
